loudness: one-shots: event LUFS (four repeats, 0.5 s gaps, as the 19 Nov combat pass); loops: integrated LUFS of the mastered loop

events.learn: a steel part (pistol, frame, tool) has landed on the rubber work mat
a light alloy part (servo case, sheet, plate) has landed on the mat
a wooden grip scale has been set down on the parts mat
a wooden scale has lifted off or come against the steel frame
a steel part has gone home on a steel fixture (cradle, press bed, pocket)
a side plate has dropped onto its pegs on the grip core
a plastic part (board, cell) has been set down
a glass vial or jar has been set down
a copper part (bobbin, lead, coil) has been set down
the canvas tool roll has been put down
a tiny steel part (pin, circlip, ring, resistor) has been set down
the part will not seat: something blocks it (wrong way round, wrong order)
a spring catch has snapped home (strap over the spine, lead into its clip)
the grip has slid fully onto the pistol tang
a part is sliding along a rail against spring pressure

events.note: 2 variants: pick one per screw; set pitch from resistance
events.learn: the screw is turning; pitch follows resistance (loose low, tight high)
the first threads have caught
the screw head has seated at torque (inside the window)
BAD: the bit has slipped out of the head (wrong bit or too much force)
BAD: the head or thread has stripped (over-torque)
the seized screw has broken free after oil and taps
BAD: the screw went in crooked and binds
pliers biting a chewed screw head and turning it
a screw or small part has dropped into the steel parts dish
the vise screw is turning; pitch follows load (open low, closing high)
the vise jaws have closed snug on the part
BAD (over-tight) or press-fit load: metal under strain
the press fit has gone home: a dead stop
the vise has let go of the part
the cutters have gone through a wire or lead
a cut wire twist has sprung open
tape is peeling cleanly; keep the pace
BAD: the tape has torn
the dry leather wrap is coming away
the mallet has struck the pin punch (each tap counts)
BAD: the mallet glanced and hit the frame
the pin is walking out / being pulled
the pin has seated flush
the centre punch has marked the plate
the wire brush is scrubbing metal clean
brushing caked dust and grime off a casing
the part is swirling in solvent; grime clouding off
the part has gone into the solvent jar
the part has come out of the solvent, dripping
one drop of oil has landed
excess oil wiped off with a rag

events.note: fade out over the spin-down; pair with asm.spin.grind
events.learn: GOOD: the bearing is clean and true (long smooth whirr)

events.note: pair with asm.spin.true; must never be mistaken for it
events.learn: BAD: grit in the bearing (gritty grinding spin)
the rotor brakes within a turn (damper coil closed)
the servo rotor kicks when the tester drives the coil
the rotor is spinning under the tester (coil driven)
copper wire winding onto the bobbin; pitch follows crank speed (too fast snaps)
BAD: the copper wire snapped (wound too fast)

events.note: synthesised: padded mass hitting a damped stop
events.learn: GOOD: the damper caught the swing (one soft tick)
the mass swings once and settles (with the tick on top)
the strippers have bitten the insulation
the insulation has slid off
the bare strands are being twisted
the iron is on the work; flux is heating
GOOD: the solder has melted and flowed
BAD: a cold joint (the iron drags, nothing flows)
BAD: too hot, the insulation is scorching
the heat-shrink sleeve has tightened
a probe has touched a contact
GOOD: circuit closed, the tester lamp relay clicked on
BAD: open circuit, the tester buzzes
the scribe is cutting a line in the alloy; keep it steady
the snips have taken one bite along the line
an offcut has dropped (it is kept)
one file stroke has taken metal off
one stroke of the round file in the pocket
the hand drill is cutting; pitch follows speed, rough when pushed too hard
BAD: the bit has bound (pushing too hard)
the bit has broken through the plates
the strip is bending in the vise (yielding metal)
BAD: the strip has cracked (bent back too often)
the press lid has closed and locked
one pump stroke has raised the pressure
the press is under pressure

events.note: layer with asm.press.hiss; pitch rises with pressure into the band, steady inside it
events.learn: the nanites are knitting; pitch follows pressure (in band = steady tone)
nanite fluid pouring into the mould (stop at the line)
the press has vented
the hot core has gone into the quench
the applicator is laying the nanite seam; keep it moving
the cure lamp is on (seam curing)
the cure lamp has switched on or off
the lamp arm is swinging over
the cell latch has snapped open or home
BAD: the cell will not come out while the latch holds it
the charge cell has left or entered its contacts
the pistol status lamp has died (cell out)
the pistol has power again (amber, then cyan)

events.note: checked against Combat/Pistol body layers: must be at least 6 dB quieter in event loudness
events.learn: a low-power test pulse (clearly weaker than a real shot)
the pulse has holed the paper card
the card has been clipped to the board

events.note: pair with asm.damper.tick (after): one tick, no rattle
events.learn: BAD (before): the bare pistol rattles loose
the case clip is under the pick (pry)
a case clip has let go
BAD (cosmetic): the clip snapped off
the circlip or retaining ring has sprung off/on
a gear is lifting off its post
BAD: the spring has jumped out
a connector or tab has unplugged or plugged in
a scrapped part has gone into the scrap bin
a part has fallen to the floor
the tool roll strap is coming undone
the tool roll is unrolling across the bench
a tool has been taken from or put back in the roll
a lead is sliding along its channel (route it at a steady pace)
idle hint: look here
a stage is complete (the schematic gets its tick)
the job is complete

events.note: stereo; a synthesised lamp tick layer is added, periodic in the loop
events.learn: where you are: Brann's shop from the bench (quiet bed)

contact_matrix.note: key is "<part material>|<surface material>"; order-free lookup: try a|b then b|a then "<a>|*". Drops into the parts dish use asm.screw.dish; parts on the floor asm.part.floor; into the scrap bin asm.part.bin.
contact_matrix.mass:tiny: asm.seat.tiny_steel (any material when the part mass class is tiny, except glass and copper)

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Bench is yours. Lay it out.
lines.spoken_text: Bench is yours. Lay it out.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Cell's out. Now strip it, grip first.
lines.spoken_text: Cell's out. Now strip it, grip first.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Frame in the cradle. Servo next. Go gentle, that's the good part.
lines.spoken_text: Frame in the cradle. Servo next. Go gentle, that's the good part.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Clean that gimbal, wire it, then cut your plates.
lines.spoken_text: Clean that gimbal, wire it, then cut your plates.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Core next. The press won't forgive a dirty mould.
lines.spoken_text: Core next. The press won't forgive a dirty mould.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Core's sound. Now put the grip together.
lines.spoken_text: Core's sound. Now put the grip together.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Grip's done. Put it on the pistol.
lines.spoken_text: Grip's done. Put it on the pistol.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: That's it. Shake it, then shoot a fresh card.
lines.spoken_text: That's it. Shake it, then shoot a fresh card.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Lower one's seized. Oil it, tap it, then turn. Don't force it.
lines.spoken_text: Lower one's seized. Oil it, tap it, then turn. Don't force it.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: See that crack in the tang? That's why it walks off target.
lines.spoken_text: See that crack in the tang? That's why it walks off target.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Wrong bit. You'll chew the head.
lines.spoken_text: Wrong bit. You'll chew the head.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Head's gone. Pliers. Slow.
lines.spoken_text: Head's gone. Pliers. Slow.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Cut it short. You'll be splicing that.
lines.spoken_text: Cut it short. You'll be splicing that.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Cold joint. Dull and grey. Heat it again.
lines.spoken_text: Cold joint. Dull and grey. Heat it again.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Too far. Bend it back once. Only once.
lines.spoken_text: Too far. Bend it back once. Only once.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Little ones fly. Find it before you go on.
lines.spoken_text: Little ones fly. Find it before you go on.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Check the schematic. It shows where you are.
lines.spoken_text: Check the schematic. It shows where you are.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Empty outline on the mat. Something's still on.
lines.spoken_text: Empty outline on the mat. Something's still on.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Right tool makes it easy. Wrong one makes a mess.
lines.spoken_text: Right tool makes it easy. Wrong one makes a mess.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Hear that? Clean. That'll do.
lines.spoken_text: Hear that? Clean. That'll do.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Grinding. There's still grit in it.
lines.spoken_text: Grinding. There's still grit in it.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Keep it in the green.
lines.spoken_text: Keep it in the green.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: One tick and still. That's the damper working.
lines.spoken_text: One tick and still. That's the damper working.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Still swinging. Something's pinched in there.
lines.spoken_text: Still swinging. Something's pinched in there.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: All over the card. That's what you're fixing.
lines.spoken_text: All over the card. That's what you're fixing.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Better. Rough, but it holds.
lines.spoken_text: Better. Rough, but it holds.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Tight group. Honest work.
lines.spoken_text: Tight group. Honest work.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Look at that. I couldn't have done it better.
lines.spoken_text: Look at that. I couldn't have done it better.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Range. Go and feel the difference.
lines.spoken_text: Range. Go and feel the difference.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Leave it there. It'll keep.
lines.spoken_text: Leave it there. It'll keep.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Pick up where you left off.
lines.spoken_text: Pick up where you left off.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Packing it in? Your parts go back. What's cut stays cut.
lines.spoken_text: Packing it in? Your parts go back. What's cut stays cut.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Brann says it's steady. Show me. Three on the plate.
lines.spoken_text: Brann says it's steady. Show me. Three on the plate.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Tight. That pistol's finally pulling its weight.
lines.spoken_text: Tight. That pistol's finally pulling its weight.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Wide. Breathe out, then squeeze. Again.
lines.spoken_text: Wide. Breathe out, then squeeze. Again.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Steady. I'll log the order. Keep that grip clean.
lines.spoken_text: Steady. I'll log the order. Keep that grip clean.
